notes.title: HOTFIX June 21st is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the player would sometimes climb up enemies with the yellow power
Fixed an issue with the main menu where some elements got occluded in some screen resolutions
Fixed a broken link on the Twitter button in Main Menu
Reworked the way the super mode works! The orange bar will no longer decay and you can now press a button to control when you want to enter super mode.
